text: 🧱 THE DAILY BLOCK · TUE 6 OCT ₿ BTC $85,392 (-0.4%) · ETH $2,700 (-0.4%) · Fear & Greed 73 🇮🇳 NIFTY 22,711 at the close (+0.7%) · SENSEX 72,883 ⚡ One year ago today Bitcoin set its record of $126,080. It trades near $85,400 now, about 32% below that high. The arithmetic most people skip: a 32% fall takes a 48% rise to undo, because the climb back is measured from the smaller number. Bitcoin is already up about 48% from July's $57,740 low and still a third under the record. ⚖️ The CFTC opened its first move toward federal rules for crypto trading on borrowed money. Two rule sets, Regulation CTX and CAM, would let a new class of registered market offer margin trading under one federal regime. Spot trading is left out and a 60-day comment window runs first. 🏦 Yesterday we flagged Saylor's Sunday teaser. It landed. Strategy filed on Monday: 334 BTC for $28.7M, taking the stack to 848,000 BTC at an average cost of $75,441, about 13% under today's price. 🇮🇳 RBI decides tomorrow. The call lands Wednesday at 10am with the governor's press conference at noon.
